Sub-series with their own discards — best 3 in a best-5 season, and a no-discard points table

RRS A2.1 — the sailing instructions may change the number of races excluded from a boat's series score, and they may say so table by table: ISORA's season counts the best 5 results, its coastal series the best 3, and its Points Series every race.

Scoring system: SCRATCH · Discards: The best 5 races count; each fleet discards the rest of the races it sailed.
